I am completely blown away!!! 
It’s midnight and I’ve just wrapped up my first ever day on FSD v14.3.3!!

I honestly am in awe at what a professional driver my car is now! It has gone from being a cautious grandma, to an assertive boss!!

I doubted some of the guys on a space early this morning that it would be able to handle Australian roundabouts with expertise, and boy was I mistaken!!! This version NAILS roundabouts with ease! Not only does it enter them at a perfect speed, it accelerates out of them with full force and confidence! Legitimately brought a smile to my face. 

It’s now fully proactive and asserts itself with lane changes and makes sure that it gets into the right lane WELL IN ADVANCE before it has to take an exit. It now also consistently INDICATES every time 2 lanes merge into one. And the moment there’s a speed zone change it reacts immediately to either accelerate or de-accelerate without no delay!  Legitimately addresses all the complaints we previously had with FSD here in Australia!

Oh! And not to mention, it can find a supercharger in a basement of a building and park automatically now! When before it would bail at tight corners in underground carparks. 

This version feels like it now honours my time. It’s incredibly fast to react, decisive to make a move and has no hesitation in accelerating quickly to get up to speed. There’s no longer a trade-off with choosing FSD or getting to your destination in a hurry. It’ll make sure you get there safely and  effectively!

I freaking love FSD!!! Thank you so much to the incredible team and everyone else that made this happen! I am incredibly over the moon with this! Lots of love 🫶

Enjoy my full 2 hour video of FSD v14 here Down Under!! 🇦🇺🇦🇺

Six years ago today, I woke up at 5:30 a.m. excited to start my first day of work as a consultant. I had planned and prepared for this opportunity for as long as I can remember. I headed to my first gig as an independent contractor, which ironically, was at a local hospital. I took the footage and received the orientation I needed, and went home on that very rainy day.

I had just finished digging up my backyard and moving stone there for a landscaping project. I listed the leftover pallets for sale on a few marketplaces and had buyers stopping by to pick them up that day. To be productive and to be available as people arrived, I decided to climb a ladder to trim a tree in my front yard. And then the world went black.

Today, I woke up at 5:30 a.m. not excited to relive my accident. It is the first time that the days lined up as they did in 2020, with completion of my landscaping project on Monday, dates with my now-wife on Tuesday and Thursday, and a Friday gig to launch my independent career. Rather than dreading this day, I awoke to see this interview posted with @teslaownersSV. 

Not only were John and Stephen incredibly gracious to me, making me feel comfortable out of my comfort zone, I awoke to see many kind and supportive comments. When I was fighting for my life in the ICU, I told God I wanted to live if I could marry my girlfriend and serve Him together. Today, thanks to John and @stephenpallotta, I realized that dream by sharing Jesus with all of you.
